name: Perf Profiler
description: A live per-tick simulation performance HUD. Reads the engine's own shared timing arrays — manager tick duration, its counters, and the per-worker completion times — and puts them on screen as they happen, so you can see where a frame's time actually goes instead of guessing. Press J.
author: Matt

enabled.descriptionKey: If this row is visible in Options > Mods, the mod loaded. Press J in game.
